Privacy

This is an architectural prototype. House choices are processed in your browser. There is no customer account or enquiry form.

Optional analytics

When enabled by the operator and accepted by you, Google Analytics measures visits, active engagement time, approximate location, device information and configuration choices. Google receives technical connection data. We do not ask for precise GPS location or send names, email addresses or form content in configuration events. Google Analytics may set analytics cookies. No advertising features are intentionally enabled.

Declining leaves Google Analytics unloaded. You may change your choice using Analytics settings on the configurator. Withdrawal stops future measurement; it does not erase data already collected. Analytics blockers and consent choices mean visitor counts are incomplete.

Storage and hosting

Your consent choice and timestamp are stored locally for 180 days. Local storage and analytics cookies can also be cleared in browser settings. Cloudflare processes network data to deliver and secure the website, independently of optional analytics. Google may process analytics data internationally under its applicable terms and safeguards.
